top_choice_rationale: The Bistritzer-MacDonald flat-band prediction is a transparent, one-parameter mechanism, and the 2018 discovery of correlated insulators and superconductivity at the predicted magic angle has been reproduced by many independent groups and extended to other moire systems. A phenomenological citation limited to the flat-band prediction and the observed phases is defensible, but eight years is short, the pairing mechanism is open, and Yuan Cao and earlier band-structure theorists are left out. P001 is a close second and I would accept it without hesitation, since its two-name credit is cleaner and its record longer, though the lineage with the 2005 and 2012 prizes is not settled. Awarding nothing is the weakest outcome, since both proposals recognise real, reproduced achievements.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; no collaboration with any credited person. Gothenburg physics proximity to Olsson and Johansson at Chalmers is institutional only.
